answers.core: The tooling for creating the settings window already exists in the editor, but it simply cannot be exposed in game yet. Of course it is possible to create a parody of the settings panel trough an AddOn, but I feel like this would overall be wasting time.
answers.workaround: As described, this is highly complex to code around.
